definedness_masks.use: preserve the frozen S2 component inclusion masks and validate the unchanged C2 composite divisor

provided_feature_fields.use: perturb only overture_building_microsoft_source_share; three facility counts are consulted only to reconstruct the already-frozen S2 POI definedness mask, held constant across scenarios

sensitivity_design.composite_rule: Arithmetic mean over the frozen S2 defined transport/building/POI components, with zero fallback only if no component is defined.
sensitivity_design.delta_metric: scenario composite score minus frozen S2 coverage_gap_score, summarized as absolute deltas
sensitivity_design.materiality_rule: material if any region-offset p95 absolute score delta exceeds 0.05
sensitivity_design.share_rule: For finite provided share s, recompute building_gap = frozen C2 building_gap * (1 - clip(s + offset, 0, 1)); missing share preserves the frozen C2 building component. Other frozen S2 components and S2 defined masks are held fixed.
